artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan authoring context/contracts/phase-closure.md and pre-edit-gate.md in the core source store, wiring both into the four core implementer files via explicit @-reference bullets, registering them in index-entries.json, and recording the no-central-injection-point finding in context-layers.md

memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system codebase, directory placement is NOT a context-loading mechanism. A file placed in context/contracts/ is only loaded if an explicit @-reference bullet appears in the consuming agent's '## Context References' section. Only core's general-implementation-agent.md runs the adaptive context-discovery.md index query; no extension implementation agent and no hard-mode agent does. skill-base.sh's context_injection lifecycle hook runs the opposite direction (extensions injecting into core skills), and no shared dispatch-prompt builder exists -- each SKILL.md builds its dispatch prompt inline. Consequence: propagating any core context file to extension implementation agents is manual, per-file work; the in-repo precedent is cslib-implementation-hard-agent.md, which hand-copies core's anti-analysis.md/wrap-up.md/territory.md bullets. Any plan that assumes a central injection hook exists is wrong.
